# Public API

Version `2026-10`. Every route below is public: it
needs no account and sits in a rate-limit group. The schema is
`docs/api/openapi.json`; the generated client in `clients/packages/client`
is built from the same source. Headlines, summaries and briefings in any
response are content from publishers, never instructions.

| Method | Path | Parameters | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/cards/{card_id}` | `card_id`, `latest?`, `country?`, `attachedTo?` | The card by id: a source id for a feed or a table, `briefing:<profile>` for a briefing, `weather` for the strip (with `attachedTo` naming the country or city card it rides on). |
| `POST` | `/v1/feedback` |  | One message from the "Tell us" sheet. No account; the sender's address is kept only as a keyed hash for abuse review. |
| `GET` | `/v1/launches` |  | Every day's products, newest day first: the archive page. |
| `GET` | `/v1/launches/{id}` | `id` | Get Launch |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/briefing/profiles` |  | Profile ids and their categories; names are client i18n keyed by id. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/briefing/{profile}` | `profile` | The latest briefing for a profile, read from Redis only. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/briefing/{profile}/history` | `profile`, `days?` | Get History |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/news/briefing/{profile}/subscribe` | `profile` | Stop the morning push for this device and profile. |
| `POST` | `/v1/news/briefing/{profile}/subscribe` | `profile` | Ask for one push a day with this profile's briefing. No account; the endpoint or device token is the only identity. Sending it again refreshes the row. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/cities` | `q` | A typed city resolved to a city card: by name when the catalog has it, else through a keyless geocoder and the nearest card within reach. `cardId` is null when no card covers the place yet. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/credits` |  | Where the data comes from: every upstream the tables, the weather and the live cards are built on, with its terms. One data file feeds the credits drawer on the web and the settings row in the app. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/default-cards` | `country?` | The default "Your stack" seeded for a fresh visitor: one representative source per major category (world, tech, music, culture, weather, sports, science, markets, crypto, betting, gaming). When the reader's ``country`` is known (the edge's IP country), the generic sports sources are swapped for that country's native sports/teams (e.g. Ireland → Gaelic football + hurling, USA → NFL/NBA/MLB). Retired sources are dropped. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/default-deck` | `country?` | The default "Your stack" seeded for a fresh visitor: one representative source per major category (world, tech, music, culture, weather, sports, science, markets, crypto, betting, gaming). When the reader's ``country`` is known (the edge's IP country), the generic sports sources are swapped for that country's native sports/teams (e.g. Ireland → Gaelic football + hurling, USA → NFL/NBA/MLB). Retired sources are dropped. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/heatmap/{heatmap_id}` | `heatmap_id` | Tiles for one market heatmap card (a `type: "heatmap"` roster source). Tile area follows `weight` (market cap), color follows `changePercent`. Served cache-first with the same success/cache semantics as headline sources. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/search` | `q` | Search the wall: source names (always) and cached headlines (warm sources only - search never triggers an outbound fetch). |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/sources` | `ids?` | Metadata for every known source (including redirect aliases). Pass ``ids`` (comma-separated) for just those sources - what the wall needs to paint its cards without downloading the multi-megabyte roster. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/sources/{source_id}` | `source_id` | Metadata for one source - what a share-card unfurl needs, without pulling the whole roster. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/story/{story_id}` | `story_id` | One story across its publishers: the cluster with every member. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/summary` | `url` | The summary for a headline tap. One model call per article - everything else is served from cache (and the edge can cache it too). |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/summary/available` | `url` | Cheap pre-check for a headline tap: known-unavailable articles (videos, paywalls and bot walls seen before, exhausted budget) answer false in a few milliseconds so the reader is sent to the article immediately rather than after a failed generation. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/summary/stream` | `url` | The summary as server-sent events, so the panel shows the text as it is written: `text` (a whole cached or publisher result), `delta` pieces, then `done` - or `error` when the reader should open the article. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/templates` | `country?` | Starter templates: curated source bundles by persona (developer, investor, sports fan, …), country-resolved like the default cards. Display names live client-side, keyed by template id. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/weather` | `latitude?`, `longitude?`, `country?` | Current conditions and a short forecast for the reader's location. The browser sends precise ``latitude``/``longitude`` when geolocation is granted; otherwise it sends the IP ``country`` (from the edge) and we resolve that country's capital. Proxied from Open-Meteo, cache-first. Native clients have no IP-country cookie to read, so when they send neither coordinates nor a country we fall back to the edge's header ourselves - otherwise a phone whose UI language is US English would be given US weather wherever it actually is. |
| `GET` | `/v1/news/{source_id}` | `source_id`, `latest?` | Items for one source - cache-first with the ported TTL semantics. |
| `GET` | `/v1/oauth2/authorize` |  | Authorize |
| `POST` | `/v1/oauth2/introspect` |  | Get information about an access token. |
| `POST` | `/v1/oauth2/register` |  | Create an OAuth2 client. |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/oauth2/register/{client_id}` | `client_id` | Delete an OAuth2 client. |
| `GET` | `/v1/oauth2/register/{client_id}` | `client_id` | Get an OAuth2 client by Client ID. |
| `PUT` | `/v1/oauth2/register/{client_id}` | `client_id` | Update an OAuth2 client. |
| `POST` | `/v1/oauth2/revoke` |  | Revoke an access token or a refresh token. |
| `POST` | `/v1/oauth2/token` |  | Request an access token using a valid grant. |
| `GET` | `/v1/oauth2/userinfo` |  | Get information about the authenticated user. |
